scores.notes: Left shows an unparted stormy sea at a rocky palm-lined shore under a dark night sky with no dry path at all; right is a daylit sand corridor between two water walls with red mesas beyond.
Daniel in both is an older man with short grey hair, short grey beard, tan skin and slim build in a blue robe over a white tunic (left standing before the king, right small but clear in the pit).
Left is a daylit sandy corridor between towering water walls with red cliffs at left; right is an unparted stormy sea at a rocky palm shore at night with no dry path visible.

Left Jesus is clear (shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, standing in the boat); on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the centre cross with head bowed, too small to compare the face beyond dark hair.
Both show a grassy lawn enclosed by a red brick garden wall with leafy trees under a soft cloudy daytime sky, with croquet elements (card arches left, card soldiers, flamingos and hedgehogs right).
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face and build, and a white tunic under a grey-blue mantle (standing in the boat left, on the water right).
Watson in both is a stocky middle-aged man with brown hair, a full brown moustache, fair skin, dark suit, bowler and doctor's bag (seated left in the carriage, at the door on the right).

Peter in both has dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short greying beard, tanned skin and sturdy build in a rough brown cloak with a net slung on him (standing with staff left, leaping from the boat right).
Watson in both has brown hair, a thick brown moustache, fair skin and a solid build with bowler and black bag; smaller on the right but the moustache and face shape match.

Left Holmes (striking with the cane) has a full head of slicked-back dark hair; right Holmes (thin man at the door) is clearly balding with a bare crown and high domed forehead, a conflicting hair cue despite similar gaunt build.
The house behind the table conflicts: left is a thatched half-timbered cottage with climbing roses, right is a grey clapboard house with a columned porch; table, tree and lawn are otherwise alike.

Watson in both is a sturdy fair-skinned middle-aged man with brown hair and a full brown moustache; the left moustache has slightly upturned tips and he looks a little younger, but no clear identity cue conflicts.

Taking Watson on the left as the man Holmes pulls by the arm (sandy-brown hair, moustache, brown suit), he matches the right Watson (brown hair, moustache, brown tweed suit, similar age); note the left also has a second moustached man in a bowler with a bag, which makes the pick less certain.
David in both is a slim clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair and tan skin in a short brown tunic (slinging at left, dodging the spear at right).
David in both is a clean-shaven youth with short dark-brown curly hair, the same boyish face and lean build, in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder satchel.
Holmes in both is a gaunt, pale, clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, hollow cheeks and a hawkish nose in a dark frock coat (stooping with cane left, seated in profile with pipe right).

Both show the same kind of open single-masted wooden fishing boat on a grey-green choppy lake with an olive-brown hilly shore at the right; the right adds a torn sail and distant boats, but the lake and coast are compatible.
Alice in both is a girl of about the same age with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair, fair skin and a frowning face, in a yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.
Moses in both is an elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard and weathered tan skin in a cream tunic and brown mantle (striking the rock left, seated between two men right).
Watson in both is a middle-aged fair-skinned man with side-parted brown hair and a full brown moustache, similar sturdy build (seated in profile left, arms crossed right).

Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face, wearing the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; smaller on the right but hair and face match.
Watson in both has side-parted brown hair, a full brown moustache, fair skin and a stocky build with waistcoat and doctor's bag (seated on the bed left, at the door right).

Moses in both is an old man with wind-blown white hair and a long white beard in a cream tunic and brown mantle; left is a three-quarter back view but hair, beard and build match the seated figure on the right.

Both show a wet sandy corridor running to a vanishing point between two towering curling walls of blue-green water under a dark stormy sky; the right shows more rocky cliffs at the far end but nothing conflicts.

Peter (the man raising the beggar at left; foreground man with net and staff at right) has short dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grizzled beard, deep tan skin and a sturdy build in a rough brown cloak in both.

Alice in both is a small girl with long straight light-brown hair and fair skin in a pale yellow dress with white pinafore and striped stockings; on the right she is small and in profile, but hair, age and build agree.

Alice in both has long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, a child's slight build and the yellow dress with pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; the left is a small profile view but nothing conflicts.

David in both is a slim clean-shaven boy with short dark curly hair and tan skin in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder satchel; he looks a touch younger with head bowed on the right, but no cue conflicts.

Left Daniel (being hauled out of the pit) has close-cropped grey hair and darker tan skin; right Daniel has thick wavy collar-length hair streaked dark and grey, a longer face and lighter skin, despite the same blue robe and scroll.

Left Daniel has thick wavy collar-length grey-and-dark hair and lighter skin; right Daniel in the pit has close-cropped receding grey hair and darker skin and looks older, with only the blue robe in common.

Both show an open single-masted plank fishing boat with rope rigging on a dark blue choppy lake ringed by low hills under storm cloud; the right adds a torn sail and bigger waves, which the storm-then-calm change explains.

Moses in both is an elderly man with swept-back white hair, a full white beard and tan skin in a cream tunic with dark sash and brown mantle, holding a staff; skin is slightly darker on the left but face and build match.
David in both is a slim clean-shaven boy with short dark curly hair in a rough brown tunic; his head is bowed on the right so the face is partly hidden, but hair, age and build agree.

Both show the same kind of wooden boat with a lit lantern hung at the mast and a ragged pale sail on a lake backed by dark hills under heavy cloud; the right shore is nearer with villages, but that fits a different viewpoint and the storm-to-calm change.

Both have a long table on grass under a large spreading tree with a grey clapboard house with a porch behind; the left table is bare wood and the right has a white cloth and an armchair, but house, tree and lawn match.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a lawn beneath a big tree with a reddish-brown timbered, gabled English house behind; the house is farther off on the left and close with bay windows on the right, a viewpoint difference rather than a clear conflict.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a leaf-strewn lawn under a large tree with a brick-and-half-timber Tudor-style house behind; the house is close with bay windows on the left and farther off with gables on the right, which a different viewpoint could explain.

Peter (stepping onto the water at left; lifting the beggar at right) has short dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grizzled beard, tan skin and a strong build in a rough brown cloak in both.

Both show a calm, misty Sea of Galilee at low sun with hazy steep hills around the water and a scrubby shoreline; the left sees the shore from the boat and the right from the beach, with no conflicting feature.

Both show a small wooden fishing boat swamped by steep dark waves at night with the moon breaking through storm cloud; the left adds a hillside shore and a furled sail while the right has open water and a set sail, but the stormy night lake matches.
The cat's coat colour conflicts: left is a grey tabby with dark grey stripes, right is a ginger/orange-brown tabby; both have the wide toothy grin and stripes.
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same slim build and long face, in a white tunic with a grey-blue mantle (on the water left, calling at the tomb right).
Watson in both is a stocky fair-skinned man with brown hair and a thick brown moustache, similar age and jaw, with bowler and black bag (at the door left, seated in the carriage right).
Watson in both has side-parted brown hair, a brown moustache, fair skin and a similar age and build; his hand shades his eyes on the left but hair and moustache are clear.

Alice in both is a slight young girl with long light golden-brown hair in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; on the right she is small and seen mostly from behind, so the match rests on hair, age and build.

Alice in both is a young girl with long wavy golden-brown hair, fair skin and a worried round face in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; smaller on the right but face and hair match.
Moses in both is an old man with white hair and a full white beard in a cream tunic with dark sash and brown mantle, holding a staff; he is small on the right but hair, beard and build clearly match.
Daniel in both is an older lean man with close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in a dark blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a scroll case at the hip.
Alice in both is a girl of the same age with long wavy golden-brown hair held by a blue band, fair rosy skin and a round face, in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Daniel in both is an older lean man with close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin wearing a dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic; he is smaller on the left but hair and beard match.
Peter (leaping from the boat at left; raising the beggar at right) has short dark curly hair with grey, a short grizzled beard, tan skin and a sturdy build in a rough brown cloak in both.

Left Holmes is a gaunt older man with slicked-back dark hair and a high receding hairline; right Holmes (pulling the man through the door) is clearly younger with a thick tousled curly mop and a fuller face.

Moses (foreground with staff at left; the staff-bearer leading the crowd at right) is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and tan skin in a cream tunic and brown mantle in both; small on the right, and a near-twin elder walks beside him, but nothing conflicts.
Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a round serious face in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both show a grey overcast Sea of Galilee with dark hills and a stony pebble shore where a small coal fire burns beside the waiting Jesus; the right adds a village with palms across the bay, compatible with a closer viewpoint.

Both show a wooden fishing boat with a lit lantern on a black, heaving lake at night with the moon breaking through storm cloud and a faint dark shoreline; the right adds distant boats but nothing conflicts.
Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and the same round face in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Peter (raising the beggar at left; wading ashore in a pale tunic at right) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly greying hair and a short grizzled beard in both; the hair reads a little greyer on the right but face, beard and build match.

Both are night views of flat open farmland with hedgerows and scattered trees and a fire sending smoke into a dark blue sky; the left sees the blaze from the station far off and the right stands in the grounds of the burning white house, which is compatible.
